title: Pochettino begins at Anfield with United in the bottom three
summary: Mauricio Pochettino takes charge of Manchester United for the first time at Anfield on Sunday, with United 18th on eight points and Liverpool fourth on 18. Liverpool have won once in five home league games, while United are without Manuel Ugarte, Benjamin Šeško and Carlos Baleba; Lisandro Martínez returns from suspension. Pochettino has never lost his first match as a manager, with two wins and four draws.
